label: default agent • create a folder watcher
query: Watch my ~/Downloads folder and organize new files into subfolders by type whenever something lands there.
notes: Gap-closure write surface: the new osaurus_watcher domain. Pins action 'create' with the Downloads path. Watchers require a custom agent_id (the Default agent is refused with a typed error naming osaurus_agent), so the happy path is agent create -> watcher create; the extra iterations cover that recovery. The tool also validates the directory exists, so on eval hosts without ~/Downloads the call still counts for selection scoring.
